theme: Handoff day: pick up the girls, then point the car at Orlando.
greeting: Morning, Dan. The calendar is clear right up to the 3 o'clock pickup, and then the day turns into four kids and the drive to the Disney weekend.

needsAttention.title: Confirm the rental SUV before the 3 PM pickup
needsAttention.detail: The Orlando villa starts tonight and the Sept 20-Oct 5 full-size SUV is the only way to get all six of you there. The Todoist item is still open, so make sure it's actually booked before you head to the pickup.

needsAttention.title: Claire's St Pete appointment vs. Orlando
needsAttention.detail: A 10:20 AM appointment for Claire in St Pete sits on your calendar for tomorrow, but the trip has you in Orlando through the 27th. Worth settling tonight which one actually holds.

needsAttention.title: Book the Maine Christmas SUV
needsAttention.detail: Flagged p1 in Todoist since Sep 14. A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas week is the tightest rental in that market and sells out early — a refundable hold now costs nothing and removes the risk.

needsAttention.title: Disney tickets are the last open item
needsAttention.detail: Tickets for six are the only thing left unbooked for Sat-Sun. Check whether your ticket type needs park reservations, and whether a Magic Kingdom Halloween party night changes the plan.

schedule.title: Pick up the girls
schedule.detail: Collect the four in St Pete, then drive to Orlando

flagged.title: Toronto ICGN dinner and ticket
flagged.detail: Jen Sisson asked her team to add you to the dinner invite and sort a complimentary ticket — a quick reply confirming you're in wraps it up.

flagged.title: Two LinkedIn messages waiting
